hero.paragraph: Packton connects Rwanda through fast, reliable last-mile delivery. Whether you are a business sending hundreds of daily orders or an individual sending a gift, we make sure it gets there.

valueProposition.paragraph: We move beyond generic delivery services by acting as an extension of your business. Reliable, transparent, and built for scale.

features.title: Pre-Dispatch Verification
features.description: No more wasted trips. We personally call the recipient to verify coordinates before a package leaves our hub.

features.title: 48h COD Payouts
features.description: Stop chasing money. Cash collected is audited and remitted directly to your bank account within 48 hours.

features.title: Partner Dashboard
features.description: Manage bulk orders, monitor delivery status, and track your payouts through our secure partner portal.

howItWorks.heading: How we deliver.
howItWorks.paragraph: Simple, transparent, and built on our core promise: we confirm before we move.

steps.title: Book & Upload
steps.description: Individuals book instantly online. Businesses upload their daily manifest via our secure B2B portal or API.

steps.title: We Confirm
steps.description: Our dispatch team calls every recipient to verify location and availability before a rider ever leaves the hub.

steps.title: Deliver & Remit
steps.description: Your package arrives safely. Cash on delivery is collected and remitted to your account within 48 hours.

homeServices.heading: Explore our services.
homeServices.paragraph: From bulk B2B deliveries to urgent individual parcels, we turn logistics challenges into operational efficiency and scalable results.

services.title: B2B Bulk Delivery
services.description: Upload your client list — we confirm, deliver, and collect cash on delivery. Full dashboard to track every order in real time.

services.title: B2C Individual Parcels
services.description: Call us, WhatsApp us, or book online. We pick up from your door and deliver anywhere in Rwanda — same day or next day.

services.title: Cash On Delivery
services.description: We collect payment at the door on your behalf and remit to you within 48 hours. No chasing clients — we handle it.

services.title: Status Updates
services.description: Every delivery gets a unique tracking number. Sender and recipient both get SMS updates at every stage — booked to delivered.

services.title: Business Dashboard
services.description: B2B clients get a full portal — upload orders, track deliveries, view COD reports, and export data. All in one place.

services.title: Cross-Border Delivery
services.description: We deliver beyond Rwanda — Uganda, DRC, Burundi, Tanzania. One partner for all your regional logistics needs.

quickFacts.paragraph: We confirm every location before dispatch to eliminate failed deliveries. Your packages arrive safely, and cash collected on your behalf is remitted directly to you within 48 hours.

faq.paragraph: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and our operations team will get back to you directly.

items.q: How fast do you deliver inside Kigali?
items.a: Most local orders are picked up, verified, and delivered within 2 to 4 hours, depending on the chosen urgency tier and package sizing.

items.q: How does the Cash on Delivery (COD) workflow function?
items.a: When booking a parcel, specify the required COD collector amount. Our rider verifies the funds directly upon handoff, logs the successful receipt on our platform, and our treasury initiates a payout loop back to your verified account within 48 hours.

items.q: What regions do you fully cover?
items.a: We offer full-scale delivery solutions throughout Kigali, route links upcountry to major provincial hubs, and coordinate structured cross-border transport options.

items.q: What happens if a delivery attempt fails?
items.a: If a recipient is unreachable or unavailable, our riders log the attempt and securely return the package to our hub. We automatically schedule a second delivery attempt for the following business day at no extra base charge.

items.q: Can I integrate my e-commerce store with Packton?
items.a: Absolutely. We provide a robust API and plug-and-play integrations for platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce, allowing your orders to automatically generate dispatch requests in our system.

items.q: Do you handle bulky or oversized cargo?
items.a: Yes. While our primary fleet consists of dispatch motorcycles for speed, we operate a dedicated fleet of cargo vans and light trucks for oversized deliveries, furniture, and bulk B2B inventory transfers.

items.q: How do I track my active shipments?
items.a: Every dispatch generates a unique tracking link. Both you (via your Business Dashboard) and the recipient (via SMS) can track the package status from the moment it leaves the hub until the final signature is collected.

ctaBanner.paragraph: Experience clean logistics mapping with no guesswork. Set up your delivery route parameters instantly.
